versions.subject: split powershell_suspicious_download.yml
versions.detection:
downloadfile:
    EventID: 400 #  get 400 ,403 and 600 for 1 execution
    HostApplication|contains|all:
        - 'System.Net.WebClient'
        - '.DownloadFile('
downloadstring:
    EventID: 400
    HostApplication|contains|all:
        - 'System.Net.WebClient'
        - '.DownloadString('
condition: downloadfile or downloadstring
